sources.title: Nonidentifiability of the Two-State Markovian Arrival Process
sources.doi_type: Journal publication DOI verified on primary publisher page and full PDF
sources.read_scope: Primary full-PDF section 2; section 4 definition 4.1, theorem 4.2 and scope; page 641 MMPP2 distinction. Not all technical appendix derivations were read.
sources.evidence: The arrival kernel and resolvent product are given in equations 2.1, 2.4, 2.5. General stationary unmarked MAP2 is nonidentifiable; the paper distinguishes identifiable-up-to-permutation MMPP2. The theorem is not extended here to all marked or constrained models.
